headline_en: DCENT $6.57M theft, plus others – 3 new incidents
briefing_ko:
- **[DCENT](https://x.com/DCENTWALLETS/status/2100076991798206573)** (—) — DCENT App Wallet에서 $6.57M 자산이 탈취되었습니다.
- **[Flamincome](https://x.com/SlowMist_Team/status/2100256590716907706)** (Ethereum) — 플래시 론으로 LP를 주입해 $345.9K를 탈취했습니다.
- **소액** — Startale $2.9K
- **시사점** — 스마트 계약 취약점을 이용한 공격이 연속 발생하고 있습니다.
briefing_en:
- **[DCENT](https://x.com/DCENTWALLETS/status/2100076991798206573)** (—) — $6.57M was stolen from the DCENT App Wallet.
- **[Flamincome](https://x.com/SlowMist_Team/status/2100256590716907706)** (Ethereum) — attacker used a flash loan to inject LP and siphoned $345.9K.
- **Smaller** — Startale $2.9K.
- **Takeaway** — Exploiting smart-contract vulnerabilities continues to be a common attack vector.
